move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your note about getting back to the machines suggests you value a straightforward negotiation without unnecessary back-and-forth. We want a competitive price supported by workable payment and delivery arrangements. What flexibility in those arrangements would help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,
thanks for the mail.
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

But I need 14 days payment to make this work for my cash flow, 42 days lead time and DAP are fine.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €15.30 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

We have free capacity for your parts.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Just write if something is unclear.
Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that volume change data into account, and we have already taken that should cost data into account. We appreciate your confirmation of the 6,000 units annual volume and your commitment to a long-term partnership.

Our present Angebot is a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

As an alternative, we offer a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW at our standard terms. To offer you a more competitive price, we must maintain a 45-day lead time, allowing us to propose €15.50 per unit.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Please share the detailed breakdown of your should-cost estimate so we can better understand the basis of your target price. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
